findings.description: Presence of uncalibrated claims such as certified sovereign mission-ready or zero false positives without third-party accreditation.
findings.root_cause: Enthusiastic marketing phraseology used in early demo scripts and UI mockups rather than empirical criteria.
findings.remediation: Replaced all uncalibrated marketing claims across docs, demo scripts, and web UI with evidence-grounded software verification statements.

findings.description: Superficial parser count discrepancy where docs cited 11, 15, or 20 parsers.
findings.root_cause: 11 referred to fuzzing subset, 15 to performance benchmark subset, while total concrete classes implemented is 20.
findings.evidence: Inspection of packages/parser-runtime/ulpf_parser_runtime/parsers/ confirmed 20 BaseParser concrete classes (10 generic, 10 specialized).
findings.remediation: Established authoritative parser truth definition TOTAL_CONCRETE_PARSERS = 20, documenting 10 generic, 10 specialized, 11 fuzz subset, and 15 benchmark subset.

findings.description: Soak test of 2500 cycles executed in ~2 seconds was characterized as long-duration sustained soak.
findings.root_cause: Labeling a high-velocity burst endurance test as long-duration sustained soak.
findings.remediation: Formally reclassified as Controlled Burst Endurance / High-Velocity Heap Stability test, accurately distinguishing burst stability from multi-hour soak.
